about: Synthetic test life for the memory-structure bake-off (2026-10-30). Fictional person, every fact invented; no owner data. Messages are what the person says to Jarvis, in date order. Questions are asked 'today' = 2026-10-30. Scoring: an answer passes when every group in 'must' has at least one alternative in the answer (case-insensitive) and no 'must_not' term appears; 'abstain' questions pass only when the answer says it doesn't know and states no value. Alternatives of 3 characters or fewer match as whole words only (so 'go' does not match 'good').

messages.text: My name is Karthik Rajan, but everyone calls me Karthi.
I live in RS Puram, Coimbatore with my family.
My wife Priyadharshini — I call her Priya — teaches maths at Sunrise Matric School.
Priya's birthday is on 14 February.
We have two kids: our daughter Anushka, we call her Anu, is 7, and our son Vikram (Vicky) is 3.
Anu's birthday is 3 August.
Anu studies in class 2 at Green Valley School.
My parents live in Madurai, that's my hometown. Appa is Ramasamy and Amma is Lakshmi.
My sister Divya lives in Bangalore and works at Infosys.
Our wedding anniversary is 22 November.
I work at Nimbus Soft as a senior backend engineer.
At Nimbus my main project is PayRail, a payments service written in Java.
My side project is FarmLink, an app that helps farmers sell produce directly. I'm building it with my friend Arjun.
FarmLink uses Next.js and Firebase.
I also run a home lab on a Raspberry Pi 5 with Proxmox.
I play cricket every Sunday morning with the Peelamedu Strikers. I'm the opening batsman.
Photography is my other hobby. I shoot with a Canon 200D.
I've started learning the veena from Mrs. Saraswathi on Wednesday evenings.
I play FIFA on my PS5 to relax at night.
My phone is an iPhone 15.
For work I use a ThinkPad X1 Carbon.
We drive a Hyundai Creta, bought in 2024. I also ride a Royal Enfield Classic 350.
We have a home loan with HDFC; the EMI is 42,000 rupees on the 5th of every month.
Our monthly household budget is 60,000 rupees.
I put 10,000 rupees a month in a Nifty index fund SIP.
I'm allergic to peanuts.
My blood group is B positive.
I walk 5 km every morning at 6.
My dentist is Dr. Kumar at Smile Care, Gandhipuram.
I'm vegetarian.
I like filter coffee with no sugar.
I prefer WhatsApp messages over phone calls.
I hate long meetings; 30 minutes is my limit.
I prefer dark mode on everything.
Our favourite restaurant is Annalakshmi.
Maybe I'll learn Japanese next year, not sure yet.
What's the weather like today?
Thanks, that helps.
Arjun handles the FarmLink backend; I do the frontend and design.
FarmLink's first pilot is with the Pollachi Farmers Collective.
We went to Japan for 10 days — Tokyo and Kyoto. Best trip ever.
I passed the AWS Solutions Architect Associate exam.
My boss at Nimbus is Suresh. He's very supportive.
என் அம்மாவுக்கு சர்க்கரை நோய் இருக்கு, மாத்திரை சாப்பிடுறாங்க.
Appa's tablets come from Apollo Pharmacy in Madurai every month.
Anu turned 8 today! We had a party at home.
Divya got married to Naveen; he's a doctor in Bangalore.
I'm starting to learn Rust in the evenings.
I sold my Canon 200D and bought a Sony A7 IV.
Big news: I've accepted an offer from Tessera Labs as an engineering manager. I start on 1 December.
Last day at Nimbus Soft today.
First day at Tessera Labs. My manager here is Meena.
At Tessera I lead the Ledgerly team; Ledgerly is a lending platform built with Go and Kafka.
We've decided to move to Chennai in March because of my new job.
We decided to prepay part of the home loan in January next year.
FarmLink is moving from Firebase to PostgreSQL; Firebase got too expensive.
Took Priya to dinner for her birthday at Annalakshmi.
We moved! We now live in Adyar, Chennai.
Anu joined class 3 at Chettinad Vidyashram in Chennai.
Priya now teaches maths at Kalakshetra School in Chennai.
Vicky started kindergarten at Little Elly, Adyar.
My new dentist in Chennai is Dr. Ananya at Pearl Dental.
I've joined the Adyar Cricket Club; we play on Saturday mornings now, not Sundays.
I switched from the iPhone 15 to a Pixel 9.
I stopped the veena classes after the move.
FarmLink is now live with 3 farmer collectives: Pollachi, Udumalpet and Theni.
Our household budget went up to 75,000 rupees a month in Chennai.
I increased my SIP to 15,000 rupees a month.
Ledgerly runs on AWS EKS.
Ravi from my team is the tech lead on Ledgerly's payments module.
Vicky turned 5 today.
Naveen and Divya had a baby boy, Aadhav.
எனக்கு ப்ரியா செய்யும் தோசை ரொம்ப பிடிக்கும்.
I'm thinking about buying an electric car, maybe next year.
We decided not to buy a new car this year.
Anu is 9 now.
My home lab moved to an Intel NUC; the Raspberry Pi is retired.
I finished the Rust book and rewrote my backup tool in Rust.
Our client for Ledgerly's first launch is Kaveri Finance.
Ledgerly went live for Kaveri Finance today.
We're planning a trip to Munnar for the Christmas holidays.
Appa's 70th birthday party will be on 9 January 2027 in Madurai.
Arjun is now FarmLink's CTO; I'm the CEO.
Meena moved to another team; my new manager is Gopal.
Priyavukku eppavum malli poo pudikkum — Priya always loves jasmine flowers.
Can you remind me what time it is?
I take Vicky to swimming classes at the Anna Nagar pool on Tuesdays.
Actually, the swimming classes are at the YMCA pool in Nandanam, not Anna Nagar.
I use Obsidian for my notes and Linear for FarmLink tasks.
Remember that my passport expires in June 2027.
My Royal Enfield needs its service; I take it to Sri Murugan Motors.
Kaveri Finance renewed the Ledgerly contract for two years.
We booked a homestay in Munnar from 23 to 27 December.
